about: The Obukhiv area: a town, the Dnipro and country houses

Obukhiv is a small town with mostly Soviet-era housing and a private sector, and nearby are Ukrainka and Trypillia on the Dnipro and Kozyn closer to Kyiv. There are many country houses here, used both for permanent living and as a dacha with a view of the water.

For apartments in Obukhiv and Ukrainka the typical task is a major renovation of older housing. For houses above the Dnipro — terraces, large windows, a sauna or pool and landscaping of a sloping plot.

On plots overlooking the Dnipro, interior design is closely tied to the architecture: where the windows are, where the living room faces, how you go down from the terrace to the garden. For apartments — a functional layout and light finishes. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments with full replacement of services, houses and cottages; details of the warranty are on the [contract, warranty, payment](/en/contract-warranty-payment) page. Plots above the Dnipro often slope, so we design for the terrain, retaining walls and drainage; for country residences see also [houses in Koncha-Zaspa and Kozyn](/en/turnkey-house-koncha-zaspa).

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
